text:
alice_acme: Hey team — our free trial credits went from ~10k to ~150 overnight. We only have one scheduled embeddings job, should not be that high. org: acme-42, sample request_id: req_9f8a7b.

eve_support: Sorry to hear that, @alice_acme. Can you share the approximate window and any request ids? We'll triage and escalate now. :wave:

alice_acme: window ~2026-03-15 02:10-03:30 UTC. saw a bunch of `429` then `500` in our logs, then many `200` successes. I pasted a log excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T02:12:01Z worker-3 POST /v1/embeddings req=req_9f8a7b status=500
2026-03-15T02:12:05Z worker-3 retry POST /v1/embeddings status=200 tokens=12 cost=0.0003
2026-03-15T02:12:05Z worker-4 POST /v1/embeddings req=req_9f8a7c status=200 tokens=12 cost=0.0003
```

sam_billing: Thanks, adding billing view. Can you confirm the API key used by the job? If prod key hit from staging that explains credits. I'll pre-authorize a provisional credit hold while we investigate.

marta_eng: Looking at the ingest service - its retry wrapper doesn't set an idempotency header. If two workers pick up the same payload they both retry on 500 and we get double-charges. Also see an env change around deploy 2026-03-14 23:58 that swapped `SYNC_API_KEY` between prod/stage clusters.

ryan_sre: Confirming deploy note — k8s rollout `ingest-sync-v2` accidentally applied `configmap: sync-keys` without namespace scoping. Staging got prod key for ~2h. That lines up with window.

ingest-bot: automated-detect: duplicate-job-count=38 duplicate-successes=33 estimated_extra_tokens=41123 estimated_extra_credits=0.82

alice_acme: Oof. So is this double-running + prod key the cause? Can you refund the excess credits? We relied on the trial for dev budget.

eve_support: Short term: we'll refund excess and apply a promo credit to restore trial to previous level. Sam — please confirm the refund amount and promo code to apply.

sam_billing: I'll issue a credit for the estimated extra_credits 0.82 and add a $50 promo trial extension for ACME-42. ETA ~2 hours once finance approves.

marta_eng: Long term fix: 1) add idempotency-key to ingest requests (use payload checksum) 2) make retry client dedupe on idempotency header 3) add k8s namespace guard to configmap updates 4) add alert when non-prod picks up prod API keys. I'll open the PR and a follow-up runbook.

ryan_sre: I'll rollback the configmap to the correct values and add a deploy gate so cross-namespace mounts are explicit. Also adding an alert rule: `kube_configmap_mismatch{env!="prod",key="SYNC_API_KEY"}`

alice_acme: Appreciate the quick action. Can you paste the support ticket number once refunds/promo applied?

eve_support: Ticket #SUP-20260315-827. We'll update here and DM you when promo is applied. :thumbsup:

marta_eng: PR: https://github.com/redwood/injest-sync/pull/142 will add idempotency + tests. Planning hotfix deploy in 3 hours.

sam_billing: Refund issued: 0.82 credits refunded. Promo code `ACME-TRIAL-50` applied for $50. Please confirm you see it in console under Billing > Credits.

alice_acme: I see the $50 promo, credits restored. Thanks everyone. Leaving this thread open until hotfix is live.

eve_support: Marking follow-ups: billing confirmed, hotfix deploy, postmortem to be posted in #postmortems. Closing when PR merged and deploy successful. :white_check_mark:
